purpose: D1 single-variable experiment: equivalent English rewrite of every dev-set query (24 answerable + 5 dev unanswerable) to test whether query language explains part of the Chinese-question retrieval failures on the English DOE corpus. Frozen before any experiment query.
rewrite_rules: Equivalence only: rewrite from the question text alone.
Preserve device ids, model numbers, numeric values, units, negation, necessity/approximation qualifiers, and time conditions.
Never add answers, document ids, page numbers, section hints, or measures not present in the question.
R17/R29/R34 reuse the frozen probe wording to avoid adding wording variance on already-probed cases.
This file is frozen: any later wording change requires a new version file; do not edit after querying.
